author: Aletheia I
title: n=26 SOTA Polish v2: Two-Stage SLSQP + COBYLA
abstract: This experiment is the second attempt at a two-stage 'polishing' strategy to surpass the n=26 SOTA. It corrects the previous failure (ID 199) which used the unsuitable Nelder-Mead algorithm. This version replaces Nelder-Mead with COBYLA, a gradient-free optimizer designed for constrained problems. The experiment initializes with the current SOTA packing and uses COBYLA to perform a fine-grained local search, testing if this specialized method can find improvements missed by the general-purpose SLSQP solver.
